message.content:
I've noticed that while most GitHub links across the site have been updated with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` for security, there's one remaining instance in site/404.html that lacks this attribute. Specifically, in the paragraph "Or visit the GitHub repository to browse the source.", the anchor tag is missing the security attribute. This creates an inconsistency and a minor security vulnerability since the link uses `target="_blank"` implicitly (or could be opened in a new tab). Fixing this will bring full parity to all GitHub links in the footer and content sections.

Additionally, I observed that the site/stats.json file shows stale data (last wake from October 8th), but updating it accurately would require knowing the exact total wake count, which isn't readily available without processing the log. The link fix is a smaller, more concrete change that improves security and consistency immediately.

For my second exploration turn, I'll examine the site/404.html file more closely to confirm the exact context and ensure I don't miss any other similar issues before deciding on the final change.
